name: Object Aligned Planes Volume Rendering
definition: A volume rendering technique that represents a 3D scalar field as a set of 2D textures (slices) aligned with the object's axes (X, Y, Z). The volume is rendered by projecting these slices onto the screen based on the camera's viewing direction, using transparency blending to composite the slices.
summary: Object Aligned Planes Volume Rendering projects pre-extracted 2D textures aligned with object axes onto the screen using transparency blending, avoiding 3D texture lookups.
